main_text.p: ribus στροφάδιω[?] ad rerum & argume-torum τάξιν τῆς συνάφειαν[?]. i. seriem & coherentiam ostendendam scripta sunt, quasi in vnum corpus colli-go, & connexione congrua & me-thodica copulo, publicique iuris in gratiam S. Theologiæ Tyronū, haud grauatim operam suam loca-te Typographo, facio.

Sub vestri autem nominis au-spicio, Reuerendi & doctissimi viri, hæc in apertum referre mihi visum, vt hoc tenui munusculo significa-tionem gratianimi vobis exhibe-rem, quando quidem nulla alia via mihi patefacta est. Te enim, Reue-rende Domine Flückingere, vsus sum præceptore ante annos plus minus viginti, in schola patria, Zof-fingæ nimirum, oppido florentis-simo; vbi ex fidelissima institutio-ne tua Græcarum & Hebraicarum

page.notes: The Greek words in the first line (στροφάδιω and the phrase after "argumē-torum") are small and only partly legible; the readings are best guesses marked [?]. The printed text has "vt", "vsus", "vbi" and "vnum"-type forms, normalised to ut, usus, ubi, unum where they occur. Tyronū is printed with a macron and kept.
